newsitem.title: UK: Gencor seeks London listing advisers-report.
newsitem.headline: Gencor seeks London listing advisers-report.

text.p: South African mining group Gencor is putting together a new team of British merchant banks to advise on its flotation on the London Stock Exchange, the Observer newspaper said on Sunday.

Gencor said on Monday it was considering accessing international markets to help fund future projects, following a report in last Sunday's Observer that it planned to float a new mining operation in London which could be worth up to one billion pounds.

Johannesburg-based dealers said Gencor's announcement was interpreted as meaning it planned the offshore listing of its Billiton offshore arm as a separate base metals company and Gencor Ltd as a precious metals company.
The Observer said Gencor has in the past week interviewed corporate finance teams from half-a-dozen British stockbrokers to back up UBS and Robert Fleming, its present advisers.
